notes:
Summary: Stonecrest Sentinel is a regional control-center operator overseeing water and power distribution for three states. They need an on-prem, air-gapped Private deployment that can run inference for operator chat assistants, incident summarization, and secure vector search over classified operational documents (CUI).

Key quotes: “We cannot tolerate external network egress for control-plane or inference traffic; all logs must be retained on-site and be auditable for 7+ years.” -- Dir. of Operations.

Security posture / asks: must integrate with existing HSM (Gemalto/Thales) for key wrapping; FIPS-validated crypto, NIST 800-53 moderate mapping, SSO via SAML/ADFS, strict retention and legal hold for logs, ability to perform offline vulnerability scans and binary supply-chain verification for any runtime artifacts. IL-like controls discussed during kickoff.

POC scope discussed 2026-03-02 meeting: air-gapped Private control plane (customer-managed), delivery of an appliance image for on-prem GPU nodes (NVIDIA A30/A100 preferred), KMS/HSM integration guide, sample dataset with redaction pipeline, and an embargoed eval harness to compare quantized model variants (70B/13B open weights) for latency/cost. Need to validate KV cache isolation and offline model rollout procedures.

Procurement/contract notes: procurement requires MSA addendum for CUI + indemnity clauses; legal requested a security checklist (submitted 2026-03-04). Pricing sensitivity: mid (expect committed monthly capacity contract).

CRM shorthand: POC target = 6 weeks post-signature, ATO gating = sec checklist + HSM cert, HW lead time = 8-12w. AE/SE alignment: Marcus + Leila to produce runbook and failback plan.

Stated latency/throughput targets: sub-200ms for 512-token chat completion (95th percentile) in control-room use; sustained throughput target ~120 qps for embeddings index rebuild windows (batch background jobs okay). Cost sensitivity: prefer quantized LLMs and batching to reduce GPU footprint.

Other notes: possible cross-team pilot with nearby municipality (adjacent use case) if POC is successful. Ask from ops: offline upgrade path and rollback snapshots must be explicitly documented.

Attachments: initial security FAQ (drive link), meeting transcript ff_meet_9931, MSA draft v0.9 on drive.
